title: Food Line source-based retrospective: documented food-access pressure in Raleigh and Bismarck
coverage_notice: This source-based retrospective contains two independently reviewed reports. It is not a complete daily edition, an exhaustive October catch-up, or proof that other October dates had no news.

items.headline: Raleigh SNAP review delay depleted household savings, resident says
items.summary: ABC11 reported that Raleigh resident Sky Hayden said a month-long SNAP review delay depleted household savings despite early paperwork. The benefits later arrived. Wake County acknowledged that some review delays occur but did not comment on the individual case.
items.limitations: This is an individual reported case, not proof that the interruption is ongoing or systemwide. Monthly application and review figures are workload counts, not delayed-case counts.

items.headline: Bismarck pantry sees fall/winter pressure as utility costs rise, KFYR reports
items.summary: KFYR-TV reported that Dream Center Bismarck staff described fall/winter food-assistance pressure as utility bills rise. Founder Jim Barnhardt said some households share rides and occasional visitors run out of fuel while seeking help.
items.limitations: The source does not establish a measured increase, shortage count, service reduction, or new meal expansion.
